name: Crawling Slurry

items.name: Motion Sense
items.text: A crawling slurry can sense nearby motion through vibration and air movement.

items.name: Splatter
items.text:
Trigger The crawling slurry takes bludgeoning damage from a creature it can sense within 10 feet

---

Effect The crawling slurry ejects a splash of acid onto the creature, dealing acid damage equal to the bludgeoning damage dealt to the crawling slurry (DC 37 basic Reflex save).

items.name: Constrict
items.text:
2d10+3 bludgeoning damage plus 2d8 acid, DC 37 basic Fortitude save

---

items.name: Crawling Slurry Acid
items.text: A crawling slurry's acid damages metals and organic materials but not stone.

items.name: Engulf
items.text: DC 37 Reflex save save, 5d10 acid damage, escape dc=37, Rupture 20. A crawling slurry regains 30 healing Hit Points if a living creature it is engulfing dies.

text: Acid damage can scar stone and reduce flesh to pitted chunks, but some organic compounds are resistant to acid and respond by combining into a mass of roiling, living slurry. These scarred clumps hunger to consume anything they can sense. They move with quick, darting contractions that surprise those used to facing slow-moving oozes.
